title: Genetic Information Nondiscrimination Act of 2008 — Statute profile
subject: Genetic Information Nondiscrimination Act of 2008
summary: Genetic Information Nondiscrimination Act of 2008 is a statute of United States enacted in 2008, in the area of employment. Bans discrimination based on genetic information in health coverage and employment. It is formally cited as Pub. L. 110-233.
key_points: Status: landmark statute of United States.
guidance: General information only, not legal advice. Use the citation to look up the current official text; statutes are amended over time.
